Navi Mumbai Bus Driver Arrested for Alleged Sexual Abuse of Toddler

A school bus driver has been arrested in Navi Mumbai in connection with the alleged sexual abuse of a three-year-old child. The incident reportedly occurred while the child was on the school bus. Authorities have taken the driver into custody and are investigating the allegations. Specific details regarding the nature of the alleged abuse or the child's condition were not provided in the coverage.
